charts.caption: Severe arm: SBP and HR, engine vs SBML extraction. The extraction crosses SBP<100 at 37.5h vs 26.6h in the real engine (10.9h lag); HR>90 shows the same ~11h lag.

charts.title: 02_severe_inflammation_match
charts.caption: Severe arm: tissue integrity (0.325/0.325) and blood pathogen (60.5/60.6) are near-identical — the extracted Acute Inflammatory Response reproduces the engine to ~1e-4. Divergence is confined to hemodynamics.

charts.title: 03_severe_9panel_engine_vs_sbml
charts.caption: Severe arm, all 9 observables, engine vs SBML extraction over 48 h. Inflammation (tissue integrity, blood pathogen) overlaps bit-for-bit; every divergence is in the hemodynamic layer. Dotted lines mark the SBP<100 / MAP<65 / HR>90 thresholds.
charts.interpretation: Severe arm, all 9 observables, engine vs SBML extraction over 48 h. Inflammation (tissue integrity, blood pathogen) overlaps bit-for-bit; every divergence is in the hemodynamic layer. Dotted lines mark the SBP<100 / MAP<65 / HR>90 thresholds.

charts.title: 04_severe_mechanism_co_svr
charts.caption: The two reach MAP≈70 mmHg by different routes: the engine collapses via cardiac-output failure with near-constant SVR (hypodynamic/low-output shock), while the extraction holds output and swings SVR — vasoconstriction then sympathetic-fatigue vasodilation (hyperdynamic/warm shock). The extraction's single AIR→sympathetic arc overshoots the vasomotor response the engine's full cardiovascular control keeps muted.
